workflow: Native kernel calibration once; GX partial_sync discovery and candidate evaluation; native validation only after GX screening. No new native profiling to choose this candidate.

runtime.note: Same runtime, CPU database and kernel database for both GX captures. Isolated stream metadata repair and host-link environment compatibility patch; shared GX checkout unchanged.

patch.change: Load only initialized logical cache slots, preserving physical ring layout and original CUDA events. Both normal and variable-capacity cache loaders use the same method. Offload buffers and D2H writes unchanged.

cpu_validation.scope: Actual CPU-executed cache methods; dense logical oracle; ring wraps, sinks, overwrites, request resets, steps, layer capacities and head shards. CUDA ordering and distributed collectives require separate validation.

limits: The 21-frame original/final pair has six cuDNN prediction misses each; strict native launch audits fail. The 81-frame pair has 27/88 misses with additional larger-shape signatures and changed cuDNN plans.
Copy-only activity is exposure, not entirely removable headroom.
GX partial_sync omits independent copy-engine contention and fixed transfer latency.
drperf covers marked main-thread CPU dispatch and reset at three cache capacities; it does not establish that every region is explained. No multi-GPU execution for this candidate.

native_validation.note: Three warmed generations per side in sequential fresh processes. Hash comparison covers the final returned video from each process, not intermediate activations.

interpretation: Selected final candidate preserves offload and D2H writeback, loads valid entries and resets metadata without clearing payload. GX models 4.177832 -> 4.041642 s; native median 5.691222 -> 5.193096 s (8.75%). Deferred writeback is excluded: its traffic reduction did not improve A100 latency. Reset CPU work loses its capacity-proportional fill term, but that produces only a small e2e gain at 21 frames.

reset_study.interpretation: Reset falls from 162.076/323.817/485.557 million instructions to 307782/307067/307266. All payload-fill instructions disappear; both models have zero unexplained share within tolerance.
